12:T4a2ef,<p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd4728-5042-11f0-9ede-456aaa662b66" style="">지난주 쾌조의 6연승을 기록한 타이거즈</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd4729-5042-11f0-9ede-0d8d061aaa0d" style="">(물론 중간에 하나 이상한 무재배가 있었...)</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd472a-5042-11f0-9ede-1d722a54da73" style="">이번주는 고척에서 키움</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd472b-5042-11f0-9ede-9b9c2ff1e538" style="">잠실에서 엘지와 만나게 됩니다</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd472c-5042-11f0-9ede-4b7905555503" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_0.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd472d-5042-11f0-9ede-d75f70768082" style="">무재배는 싫어요~ ㅠㅠ</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd6e3e-5042-11f0-9ede-df926b65ef60" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd6e3f-5042-11f0-9ede-35ceb34bab8f" style="">이번주 시간에는 키움과 엘지에게 강했던</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd6e40-5042-11f0-9ede-49102f2528f2" style="">타이거즈 선수들을 알아보겠습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cd6e41-5042-11f0-9ede-e7eff6c72064" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이름</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">오선우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.029</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">한준수</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.830</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최형우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.818</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최원준</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.814</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">김태군</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.779</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cdbc6e-5042-11f0-9ede-6b7b51dda31a" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cdbc6f-5042-11f0-9ede-357d64f8b4f9" style="">현재 1군에 있는 선수 중에 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cdbc70-5042-11f0-9ede-7d4f65df2bc2" style="">21년도부터 20타석 이상 소화한 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cdbc71-5042-11f0-9ede-ff85ed6040c5" style="">선수를 필터링하고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde382-5042-11f0-9ede-2de66a39f241" style="">그중 상대 전적 OPS TOP5를 고르면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde383-5042-11f0-9ede-136321ee327c" style="">위와 같은데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde384-5042-11f0-9ede-e7187a6b07c1" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde385-5042-11f0-9ede-4b289787b2ea" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://sports.donga.com/sports/article/all/20250622/131857008/1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="키움 대체 외인 웰스, 25일 선발등판 확정…“최대 70구까지만 던진다”"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://sports.donga.com/sports/article/all/20250622/131857008/1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        키움 대체 외인 웰스, 25일 선발등판 확정…“최대 70구까지만 던진다”
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        “70개 정도에서 끊을 것 같네요.”홍원기 키움 히어로즈 감독은 22일 대전 한화 이글스전을 앞두고 대체 외국인투수 라클란 웰스(28·호주)의 KBO리그 데뷔전 일자를 공개했다.웰스는 키움 기존 외국인투수 케니 로젠버그의 대체 외국인투수로 11일에 영입됐다. 로젠버그…
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde386-5042-11f0-9ede-d353ccb50778" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde387-5042-11f0-9ede-d51e0dda5266" style="">문제는 수요일 상대 선발이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde388-5042-11f0-9ede-e91232b68687" style="">대체 외국인 투수라는 점입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde389-5042-11f0-9ede-a1a8c92c176d" style="">올 시즌 처음 만나는 투수를 상대로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde38a-5042-11f0-9ede-0dcb1b582016" style="">기아 타자들이 기록한 OPS를 토대로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde38b-5042-11f0-9ede-5bfa7f57260b" style="">TOP5를 고르면 다음과 같은데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cde38c-5042-11f0-9ede-f56c894c6558" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이름</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최형우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.081</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이창진</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.045</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">김석환</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.918</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">오선우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.838</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">김호령</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.737</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30b9-5042-11f0-9ede-976f9a19ba00" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30ba-5042-11f0-9ede-f587aa155944" style="">두 기록을 종합해 볼 때</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30bb-5042-11f0-9ede-036bba552a45" style="">결국 최근에 잘하고 있는 선수들이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30bc-5042-11f0-9ede-4d647534b9c3" style="">활약해 줘야 한다는 너무 뻔하지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30bd-5042-11f0-9ede-5bb6cb11e93b" style="">당연한 결론이 나옵니다...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30be-5042-11f0-9ede-bf6d41fda9ad" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_1.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce30bf-5042-11f0-9ede-e1ccbb2fedac" style="">니들이 잘해야 한다...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce57d0-5042-11f0-9ede-73b22d71cc34" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce57d1-5042-11f0-9ede-0b9b4e272981" style="">상대를 LG로 바꿔서 기록을 뽑아보면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce57d2-5042-11f0-9ede-1d71705ff6cb" style="">아래와 같은 결과가 나오는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce57d3-5042-11f0-9ede-ed3d1327d6ca" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이름</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최형우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.938</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최원준</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.841</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">한준수</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.829</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">김태군</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.794</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이창진</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.768</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce7ef0-5042-11f0-9ede-93064781fa9e" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21ce7ef1-5042-11f0-9ede-63def0c18d4a" style="">2가지 케이스에 모두 이름을 올린 선수가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cea602-5042-11f0-9ede-d37c7e502eae" style="">4명이나 있습니다~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cea603-5042-11f0-9ede-075a42e36e98" style="">이 선수들의 지난주 기록을 한 번 봐볼까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cea604-5042-11f0-9ede-f3c35e465078" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이름</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">OPS</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최형우</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.289</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">최원준</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.053</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">한준수</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.629</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">김태군</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.424</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd1f-5042-11f0-9ede-830be3f09d42" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd20-5042-11f0-9ede-eb85fa389282" style="">음.. 포수 2명은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd21-5042-11f0-9ede-e500be6c732f" style="">큰 기대를 안 하는 게 좋겠군요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd22-5042-11f0-9ede-73cf238d549e" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_2.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd23-5042-11f0-9ede-01ed4796e05e" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd24-5042-11f0-9ede-9be90070eb03" style="">그리고 주목할 만한 선수 한 명을 더 뽑자면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd25-5042-11f0-9ede-8b9dea4279b5" style="">부상에서 돌아온 이창진 선수입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cecd26-5042-11f0-9ede-7f867f0a6e27" style="">현재 기이한 기록을 보여주고 있는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef437-5042-11f0-9ede-a352222a0b36" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef438-5042-11f0-9ede-4d33cc16c9f4" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://www.spotvnews.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=755239#_PA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="ABS를 지배하는 눈과 두뇌… KIA에 이상한 선수가 있다, 호세 이은 역대급 기록 나오나"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://www.spotvnews.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=755239#_PA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        ABS를 지배하는 눈과 두뇌… KIA에 이상한 선수가 있다, 호세 이은 역대급 기록 나오나
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        [스포티비뉴스=인천, 김태우 기자] KIA 외야수 이창진(34)은 2022년 111경기에서 타율 0.301을 기록하며 콘택트 능력이 있는 외야수로 인정받기 시작했다. 여기에 선구안도 있어 볼넷도 곧잘 골라내는 선수였다.하지만 순출루율(출루율-타율)이 아주 높다고 할 수 있는
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef439-5042-11f0-9ede-dddf0bb23290" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43a-5042-11f0-9ede-9fddd403bb4b" style="">기사에 나와있듯</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43b-5042-11f0-9ede-adf52e445b88" style="">원래부터 선구안이 좋았던 이창진 선수</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43c-5042-11f0-9ede-ad664361ff26" style="">올해 그 능력이 폭발하는 것 인지</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43d-5042-11f0-9ede-b5d38a425f93" style="">타율이 0.194임에도 불구하고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43e-5042-11f0-9ede-f92b1f68f8c7" style="">출루율은 0.419 입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef43f-5042-11f0-9ede-4b1de847970b" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef440-5042-11f0-9ede-7b96a6804610" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://namu.wiki/w/IsoD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,"
                        alt="IsoD"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://namu.wiki/w/IsoD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        IsoD
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        Isolated Disciple 을 줄여서 부르는 말로, 한국어로는  순출루율 로 번역된다. 타자의  선구안 , 그
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef441-5042-11f0-9ede-676d465193b2" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef442-5042-11f0-9ede-abbe11d7b1c9" style="">야구에서 출루율에서 타율을 뺀 값을</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cef443-5042-11f0-9ede-bb5a2e6b6ddc" style="">순출루율( IsoD)라고 하는데요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b54-5042-11f0-9ede-37ab091b8e32" style="">홈런타자들의 경우에 상대가 스트라이크 승부를</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b55-5042-11f0-9ede-4bc0e0a271d7" style="">잘 안 해주기 때문에 높은 경우가 있지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b56-5042-11f0-9ede-295b78e0bb09" style="">홈런타자가 아니면서 높은 선수들은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b57-5042-11f0-9ede-1dacdb5547b9" style="">정말로 선구안이 좋은 선수라는 의미입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b58-5042-11f0-9ede-7dfdb9970ca9" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_3.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b59-5042-11f0-9ede-c74473fd9718" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5a-5042-11f0-9ede-e9851c27110a" style="">올 시즌 규정타석을 소화한 선수 중에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5b-5042-11f0-9ede-67a2918db63d" style="">순출루율이 가장 높은 선수는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5c-5042-11f0-9ede-6d21b15b1a2d" style="">NC다이노스의 권희동 선수로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5d-5042-11f0-9ede-531e5fe2c438" style="">그 값이 0.167 입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5e-5042-11f0-9ede-dd9debc3c806" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_4.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b5f-5042-11f0-9ede-99f461c589b3" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf1b60-5042-11f0-9ede-8b48e6af8d0d" style="">그런데 이창진은 그 값이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4271-5042-11f0-9ede-8dd863d09613" style="">0.225니까 엄청 높은 겁니다</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4272-5042-11f0-9ede-55d694e97512" style="">위의 기사에서도 언급되고 있지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4273-5042-11f0-9ede-21ea8748ce0a" style="">01년 호세의 0.168이 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4274-5042-11f0-9ede-f596cc3e8adf" style="">프로야구 통산 최댓값이었고요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4275-5042-11f0-9ede-fba21f7442bf" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_5.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4276-5042-11f0-9ede-b7ecb3ab193d" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4277-5042-11f0-9ede-578d0de41a0d" style="">20년도 이후에는 2021년 추신수의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4278-5042-11f0-9ede-63143ff3aabe" style="">0.144가 최댓값이었습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf4279-5042-11f0-9ede-5d4cb68b33f6" style="">그렇다면 이창진의 순출루율은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf427a-5042-11f0-9ede-097ad3b94c79" style="">이대로 유지될까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf427b-5042-11f0-9ede-a1c2049e55de" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_6.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf427c-5042-11f0-9ede-3593606dd497" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf427d-5042-11f0-9ede-f1a195a55775" style="">대표적으로 높은 IsoD를 기록하고 있는 5명의 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf698e-5042-11f0-9ede-6fab74efa387" style="">통산 전반기/후반기 IsoD 차이를 바탕으로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf698f-5042-11f0-9ede-d959e1781f7b" style="">추세를 예측해 보겠습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6990-5042-11f0-9ede-3fd51fccc264" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_7.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6991-5042-11f0-9ede-01ff41b18291" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6992-5042-11f0-9ede-3d6eea767939" style="">권희동 선수를 제외하면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6993-5042-11f0-9ede-b93ccf1ac5f8" style="">시간이 지난다고 해서 순출루율이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6994-5042-11f0-9ede-65cdccff071b" style="">급격하게 변하는 건 아닌 것으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6995-5042-11f0-9ede-a5562cebbcc4" style="">특히 홍창기나, 최재훈 처럼</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6996-5042-11f0-9ede-cf1cc78e3506" style="">전략적으로 눈 야구를 하는 선수들의 경우엔</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6997-5042-11f0-9ede-794fd9b7a2ea" style="">더더욱 그러한 것 같구요</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6998-5042-11f0-9ede-297bc8fb16bd" style="">이창진 선수의 순출루율 값은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf6999-5042-11f0-9ede-5dfac5a3e97f" style="">하락할 가능성이 높습니다만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf699a-5042-11f0-9ede-03d8d3ba62b1" style="">이 선수의 통산 타율이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90ab-5042-11f0-9ede-c30af2ff0085" style="">올 시즌 타율보다는 높다는 점을 감안하면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90ac-5042-11f0-9ede-5d4301eeead9" style="">안타를 지금보다 더 많이 치되</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90ad-5042-11f0-9ede-a79b4c6b1197" style="">출루율은 유지되느냐 아니냐가</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90ae-5042-11f0-9ede-319723ab9c41" style="">관건이 되겠네요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90af-5042-11f0-9ede-d75ad239893b" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223909287932_8.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b0-5042-11f0-9ede-6782e09c0cb9" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b1-5042-11f0-9ede-49601589b8f9" style="">그런데 그거 아셨나요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b2-5042-11f0-9ede-77407b31e3a5" style="">올 시즌 기아 타이거즈의 1번 타자 출루율은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b3-5042-11f0-9ede-a74a1a7ed94b" style="">LG에 이어서 2위입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b4-5042-11f0-9ede-0fa01a26dc94" style="">리그 평균 1번 타자 출루율 0.345보다</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b5-5042-11f0-9ede-39c955559166" style="">0.17이 높구요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b6-5042-11f0-9ede-e90d571ad7b4" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cf90b7-5042-11f0-9ede-45d6da40396a" style="">이것을 두고 2가지 해석이 가능하겠죠?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfded8-5042-11f0-9ede-1bc48ba61834" style="">원래 1번 타자 출루율이 높으니</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfded9-5042-11f0-9ede-5353aef11a28" style="">이창진이 1번으로 나와서 많이 출루해 봤자</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdeda-5042-11f0-9ede-2bb097f36d51" style="">전력 상승 요인이 크지 않다?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdedb-5042-11f0-9ede-b74e342ddee6" style="">와</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdedc-5042-11f0-9ede-ab4c6c868f0d" style="">그나마 높은 1번 타자 출루율로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdedd-5042-11f0-9ede-fb177ceeca5e" style="">5할 승률 잇몸 야구를 하고 있었으니</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs13 se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdede-5042-11f0-9ede-df6ba519dc53" style="">강점을 더 강화하면 좋다!</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdedf-5042-11f0-9ede-77cfbcec25c6" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdee0-5042-11f0-9ede-25f154913c2a" style="">로 말이죠~</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdee1-5042-11f0-9ede-0dba82c763c8" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdee2-5042-11f0-9ede-d52edb4f24df" style="">여러분의 생각은 어떠신가요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21cfdee3-5042-11f0-9ede-f1068f750a51" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f4-5042-11f0-9ede-df848a4da52c" style="">참고로 작년 기아 타이거즈의</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f5-5042-11f0-9ede-630394444cc4" style="">1번 타자 출루율은 0.376으로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f6-5042-11f0-9ede-8fe3e7e0d788" style="">전체 5위였습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f7-5042-11f0-9ede-15a27b805be2" style="">리그 평균 0.370보다 0.06 높았지요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f8-5042-11f0-9ede-2bc0f054436f" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005f9-5042-11f0-9ede-633d765aed64" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-21d005fa-5042-11f0-9ede-818ec77e1ada" style="">​</span><br/></p>
